name: Izklop inštalacijskih odklopnikov
instruction:
Izklop inštalacijskih odklopnikov v peči. Če inštalacijskega odklopnika ni pojdi na naslednji korak.
Turn off the circuit breakers in the oven. If there is no circuit breaker, proceed to the next step.

name: Odstranitev folije
instruction:
Odstranitev folije iz čelnega dela peči.
Remove the foil from the oven front.

name: Kontrola tovarniške nalepke
instruction:
Preveri nalepljeno tovarniško nalepko, 2kos.
Check if all specifications are right on manufacturer sticker.

name: Zapis serijskih številk komponent
instruction:
V testni list zapiši vse serijske številke vgrajenih komponent.
On Test protocol, write down all of the serial numbers of components.

name: Tip termične varovalke 85 °C
instruction:
Preveri tip termične varovalke (85°C).
Check the type of thermal fuse (85°C)

name: Kontrola ožičenja grelcev
instruction:
Preveri ožičenje, pravilna povezava grelcev.
Check wiring and connections of heaters.

name: Kontrola ožičenja konektorjev
instruction:
Preveri vstavljenost konektorjev pri krmilnikih.
Check if connectors are plugged in to electronics.

name: Zračnost notranjega stekla
instruction:
Preveri zračnost notranjega stekla gor/dol + držalo stekla.
Check movement of inner glass (up and down) and check glass holders.

name: Dušilec v cevi dimnika
instruction:
Preveri vstavljenost dušilca v cevi dimnika.
Check muffler insertion in tub of chimmny.

name: Vodila in logo Wachtel na prekrivu ventilatorja
instruction:
Vstavi vodila in prever, če je na prekrivu ventilatorja pri pečeh Thermico in Thermico plus logo Wachtel.
Check if tray guides are inserted and check if ovens Thermico and Thermico plus have Wachtel logo on main fan cover.

name: Vodila in prekriv ventilatorja
instruction:
Vstavi vodila in prever, če je vstavljen pravilen prekriv ventilatorja.
Check if tray guides are inserted and check if correct ventilator cover is inserted.

name: Stanje Brite in št. peči na testu
instruction:
Preveri stanje Brite / št. peči na testu.
Check down a number of a counter of water filter Brita.

name: Priklop hladilnega ventilatorja zadnjega prekriva
instruction:
Priklopi hladilni ventilator zadnjega prekriva.
Plug in the cooling fan on the rear cover of the oven.

name: Priklop na testno mesto – napajalni kabel
instruction:
Priklop na testno mesto - pripravi napajalni kabel,
Connect on test spot - electric supply

name: Priklop na testno mesto – voda in napajanje
instruction:
Priklop na testno mesto - voda, pripravi napajalni kabel.
Connect on test spot - water supply, electric supply

name: Napetost LED osvetlitve na minimum
instruction:
Nastavi napetost LED osvetlitve na minimum cca 12V
Set power supply voltage for LED lights on minimum aprox 12V

name: Prenos podatkov s key-bas
instruction:
Vstavi key bas v krmlnik, nato vklopi inštalacijski odklopnik počakaj prenos podatkov ter izklopi inštalacijski odklopnik in key bas.
Insert key bas in to controler then turn on the fuse wait till parameters are transfered then turn off the fuse and key bas.

name: Priklop na testno mesto – voda, odtok agregata, napajanje
instruction:
Priklop na testno mesto - voda, odtok iz parnega agregata, pripravi napajalni kabel.
Connect on test spot - water supply, main drainage, drainage of the steam generator, electric supply.

name: Vklop proizvoda
instruction:
Vklopi proizvod (priklop napajalnega kabla, vklop varovalk v peči).
urn on the device (connect the power cable, turn on the fuses in the oven).

name: Vstavitev USB ključka s programsko opremo
instruction:
V peč vstavi USB ključek s SW-jem.
Insert the USB stick with the software into the oven

name: Zaslon Erase Flash, SD kartica in vnos SN
instruction:
Preveri zaslon: "Erase Flash", manufacturer ID SD kartice in file system. Vnesi Serisko št. Peči.
Check if the display shows "Erase Flash" manufacturer ID of SD Crd and File System. Insert serial number of oven.

name: Zvočni signal ob vklopu
instruction:
Ob vklopu peči preveri zvočni signal.
At start-up of oven check for welcome sound.

name: Vklop peči in osvetlitve
instruction:
Vklopi peč s tipko na zaslonu "ON"ali s stikalom, vklopi kontaktor K1, vklopi se osvetlitev.
Turn the oven by pressing "ON", main contactor K1 turns on, lights turn on.

name: Kontaktor K1 (brnenje)
instruction:
Preveri kontaktor K1 (brnenje).
Check main contactor for any noise.

name: Napetost na vhodnih sponkah (cca. 230 V)
instruction:
Preveri napetost na vhodnih sponkah – cca. 230V.
Measure the voltage on the circuit breaker (interphase flow approx.230AC)

name: Delovanje potenciometra
instruction:
Preizkusi deloavanje potenciometra.
Check operation of potentionmeter.

name: Delovanje ventila za vodo
instruction:
Preizkus delovanje ventila za vodo
Test water valve test

name: Natočitev vode v predal
instruction:
Natočitev vode v predal za vodo
Pourwater into the water drawer

name: Napetost na varovalkah HTBM-60 / HTBM-40
instruction:
Meritev napetosti na varovalkah peči HTBM-60(cca. 400V) in HTBM-40 (cca. 230V)
Voltage measurement at furnace fuses on HTBM-60 (approx. 400V) and HTBM-40 (approx. 230V)

name: Vnos parametrov s key-bas
instruction:
Vklpi key-bas parametri v elektroniko in vklopi peč, nato počakaj nekaj sekund da signalna lučka za OK na key-bas neha utripati
Plug the parameter key into the electronics and turn on the oven, then wait a few seconds for the signal light for OK on the key to stop flashing

name: Izklop key-bas in delovanje luči
instruction:
Nato izklopi key-bas in vklopi peč. Na to vklopi luči in preveri delovanje luči.
then take out key-bas and turn on the oven. Then turn on the lights and check the light

name: Napetost varovalk
instruction:
Meritev napetosti na varovalkah peči (cca. 400V).
Masurement of voltage at oven fuses (approx. 400V).

name: Delovanje tipk na časovniku
instruction:
Preveri delovanje tipk na časovniku
Check the operation of the keys on the timer

name: Pisk časovnika ob izteku
instruction:
Nastavi časovnik nastavi na 5 sec, preveri pisk ob izteku
Check the operation of the keys on the timer

name: Vgradnja prednjega panela
instruction:
Preveri vgradnjo prednjega panela (naleganje v kotih, odmik od zgornjega roba).
Check front panel insertion (deviations from the edges).

name: Delovanje luči v peči
instruction:
Preveri delovanje luči v peči.
Check the operation of the lights in the oven.

name: Napetost napajalnika HTB Main (15,0 V)
instruction:
Napetost napajalnika za napajanje "HTB Main" nastavi na minimum (15,0 V).
Set power supply voltage for "HTB Main" on (15,0 V).

name: Napetost LED osvetlitve (15,0 V)
instruction:
Nastavi napetost LED osvetlitve: HTB 5, FB-5, FB-8, HTBP, HTB 8, FB5-S,FB5-S CL, FB8-S,FB8-S CL, HTB 10, HTBM, FD64/FD68/FD86 (15,0 V)
Set power supply voltage for LED lights: HTB5,FB-5, FB-8,HTBP,HTB8, FB5-S,FB5-SCL, FB8-S,FB8-SCL, HTB10, HTBM, FD64/FD68/FD86 (15,0 V)

name: Vklop peči in delovanje luči
instruction:
Vklopi peč, na to vklopi luči in preveri delovanje luči.
Turn on the oven,then turn on the lights and check the light.

name: Vstop v servisni meni (koda -19)
instruction:
Vstopi v servisni meni, s kodo -19
Enters service menu, code -19

name: Nastavitev parametrov
instruction:
Nastavi parametre
Set parameters

name: Tipke na panelu
instruction:
Preizkusi tipke na panelu
Check the operation of keys on control panel

name: Zaščitni pokrovček na napajalniku
instruction:
Na napajalnika dodaj zaščitni pokrovček.
Add a protective caps to the power adapter.

name: Napetost napajalnikov PS1 in PS2 (15 V)
instruction:
Preveri napetost napajalnika PS1 (Main board Basic) in PS2 (LED luči) (15V)
Check voltage on power supply PS1 (Main board Basic) and PS2 (LED lights) (15V)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 70. Meritve v obrazcu: PS1, PS2.

name: Vstop v servisni meni (koda 1234)
instruction:
Vstopi v servisni meni, s kodo 1234.
Enter in service menu, with code 1234.

name: Datum, čas, dan in časovna kalibracija
instruction:
Nastavi datum, čas, dan in časovno kalibracijo (064).
Set date, time, and time calibration (064).

name: Vpis serijske številke in tipa peči
instruction:
Z USB ključem v krmilnik vpiši serijsko številko in tip peči.
With USB key insert serial number and type of oven.

name: General Information – tip, SN, leto, SW Main
instruction:
Preveri "General Information" (tip in SN peči, leto, programska oprema Main)
Check "General Information" (type and SN of the oven, year, program equipment Main)

name: General Information – tip, SN, leto, SW Main in IO
instruction:
Preveri "General Information" (tip in SN peči, leto, programska oprema Main in IO board-a).
Check "General Information" (type and SN of the oven, year, program equipment Main and IO board-a).

name: Izklop tretje faze (parameter 3.55)
instruction:
Izklop tretje faze: 3.55 = ON (za HTB-5) / 3.55 = OFF (za HTB-8).
Turn off third faze: 3.55 = ON (for TP-5) / 3.55 = OFF (for TP-8).

name: Jezik (ruščina) in parametri 03.53, 03.54, 17.02, 17.03
instruction:
Preveri nastavitev jezika (Ruščina) in sledeče parametre 03.53=OFF, 03.54=OFF, 17.02=ON, 17.03=ON
Check language (Russian) and following parameters 03.53=OFF, 03.54=OFF, 17.02=ON, 17.03=ON

name: Vijaki zaskočnika vrat
instruction:
Preveri, nastavi in dokončno privijači vijake zaskočnika vrat.
Check, set and check screw latch of the door.

name: Vstop v IO MENU
instruction:
Vstop v IO MENU (starejši COMM-SETUP).
Enter in IO Menu (old COMM-SETUP).

name: Induktivno stikalo vrat
instruction:
Nastavi induktivno stikalo vrat (proženje tik pred zaklepom), indik. "door".
Set inductive door switch (triggering just before lock), indic. "door".

name: Prikaz temperature komore in Main boarda
instruction:
Preveri prikaz temperature komore - T_ch in temperaturo Main board
Check chamber temperature display - T_ch and temperature of Main board

name: Vklop releja (OUT1)
instruction:
Vklop relay-a (OUT1)
Turn on relay (OUT1)

name: Vklop LED luči (OUT5)
instruction:
Vklop LED luči (OUT5)
Turn on LED lights (OUT5)

name: Elektromagnetni ventil za vodo (OUT2)
instruction:
Preizkus elektromagnetnega ventila za vodo (OUT2)
Check electromagnetic valve of water (OUT2)

name: Grelec agregata (OUT3)
instruction:
Preizkus delovanja grelca agregata (OUT3)
Check and try steam heater (OUT3)

name: Grelec komore (OUT4)
instruction:
Preizkus delovanja grelca komore (OUT4)
Check and try chamber heater (OUT4)

name: Hladilni ventilator (OUT6)
instruction:
Preizkus delovanja hladilnega ventilatorja (OUT6)
Check and try cooling fan (OUT6)

name: Glavni ventilator (OUT7)
instruction:
Preizkus delovanja glavnega ventilatorja (OUT7)
Check and try main fan (OUT7)

name: Glavni kontaktor K1 (OUT1) – luči in hladilni ventilator
instruction:
Vklop glavnega kontaktorja K1 (OUT1) vklopijo se luči in hladilni ventilator
Turn on main contactor K1 (OUT1) the lights and cooling fan turn on

name: Glavni kontaktor K1 (OUT1)
instruction:
Vklop glavnega kontaktorja K1 (OUT1)
Turn on main contactor K1 (OUT1)

name: Stikalo vrat – indikacija door
instruction:
Preveri delovanje stikala vrat, indikacija "door"
Check door switch operation, indication "door"

name: Prikaz temperature komore T_ch
instruction:
Preveri prikaz temperature komore - T_ch
Check chamber temperature display - T_ch

name: Odpiranje lopute dimnika – aktuator (OUT18)
instruction:
Preizkus lopute dimnika (aktuatorja) - vkolp (OUT18) in preveri odpiranje
Check free movement of chimney flap - on (OUT18) and check the opening of flap

name: Ventil za vodo na ventilator (OUT3)
instruction:
Test elektromagnetnega ventila za vodo na ventilator (OUT3)
Test electromagnetic valve for ventilator steaming (OUT3)

name: Kontaktor glavnega grelca (OUT4)
instruction:
Preizkus kontaktorja glavnega grelca (OUT4)
Check and try contactor for main heater (OUT4)

name: Odpiranje lopute dimnika (OUT18)
instruction:
Preizkus lopute dimnika - vklopi (OUT18) in preveri odpiranje
Check free movement of chimney flap - on (OUT18) and check the opening

name: Ventil za vlaženje agregata (OUT2)
instruction:
Test elektromagnetnega ventila za vlaženje agregata (OUT2)
Test electromagnetic valve for generator steaming (OUT2)

name: Hladilni ventilator (OUT3)
instruction:
Preizkus delovanja hladilnega ventilatorja (OUT3)
Check and try cooling fan (OUT3)

name: Glavni ventilator desno – nizka in visoka hitrost
instruction:
Preizkusi nizko hitrost (OUT5) in visoko hitrost (OUT7) glavnega ventilatorja v desno
Check and try low speed (OUT5) nad high speed clockwise rotation (OUT7) of main fan

name: Leva smer glavnega ventilatorja (OUT6)
instruction:
Vklopi levo smer glavnega ventilatorja (OUT6)
Turn on counterclockwise rotation of fan motor (OUT6)

name: Glavni ventilator levo – nizka in visoka hitrost
instruction:
Preizkusi nizko hitrost (OUT5) in visoko hitrost (OUT7) glavnega ventilatorja v levo
Check and try low speed (OUT5) nad high speed counterclockwise rotation (OUT7) of main fan

name: Delovanje luči (OUT4)
instruction:
Preizkus delovanja luči (OUT4)
Check the lights (OUT4)

name: Zapiranje lopute dimnika (OUT2)
instruction:
Preizkus lopute dimnika (aktuatorja) - izklopi (OUT2) in preveri zapiranje
Check free movement of chimney flap - off (OUT2) and check if flap is closing

name: Prikaz temperature uparjalnika T_st
instruction:
Preveri prikaz temperature uparjalnika - T_st.
Check Evaporator Temperature Display - T_st.

name: Komunikacija IO in Main boarda
instruction:
Preveri komunikacijo med IO in Main boardom (Trasmit in Recive)
Check comunication between IO and Main board (Trasmit and Recive)

name: Glavni kontaktor, odtočni ventil in LED (OUT9, OUT16, OUT22)
instruction:
Vklop glavnega kontaktorja (OUT9) + zapri odtočni ventil (OUT16) + vklopi LED (OUT22).
Turn on main contactor (OUT9) + close main drain (OUT16) + turn on LEDs (OUT22).

name: Vklop prezračevanja, dimnika in hladilnega ventilatorja
instruction:
Vklopi prezračevalni ventilator (OUT10) + odpri dimnik (OUT11) +odpri prezračevanje (OUT13) + vklopi hladilni ventilator (OUT20).
Turn on ventilation fan (OUT10) + open chimney (OUT11) + turn on ventilation (OUT13) + switch on cooling fan (OUT20).

name: Glavni ventilator levo / desno (OUT19, OUT24, OUT25)
instruction:
Test glavnega ventilatorja (OUT19+24 - levo / OUT19+24+25 - desno).
Test main ventilator (OUT19+24 - left / OUT19+24+25 - right)

name: Izklop prezračevanja, dimnika in hladilnega ventilatorja
instruction:
Izklopi prezrač. ventilator (OUT10) + izklopi OUT11 in OUT13 + zapri dimnik (OUT12) + zapri prezračevanje (OUT14) + izklopi hladilni ventilator (OUT20).
Turn off ventilation ventlator (OUT10) + turn off OUT11 and OUT13 + close chimmney flap (OUT12) + close ventilation flap (OUT14) + turn off cooling fan (OUT20).

name: Ventil za vodo na ventilator (OUT3)
instruction:
Test elektromagnetnega ventila za vodo na ventilator (OUT3)
Check and test water electromagnetic valve (OUT3)

name: Kontaktor grelca (OUT2)
instruction:
Preizkus vkolopa in izklopa kontaktorja grelca (OUT2)
Test functionality off/on of contacor heater (OUT2)

name: Odpiranje lopute dimnika (OUT6)
instruction:
Odpiranje lopute dimnika (OUT6)
Open chimney flap (OUT6)

name: Izhod za kljuko OUT18 – odklep
instruction:
Preveri delovanje izhoda za klujko OUT18. Ob vklopu izhoda se mora sistem zaklepa odkleniti in nato izkolpi OUT18
Check Function of OUT18. When turned on Lock system should unlock and then turn off OUT18

name: Izhod OUT6 – zapiranje lopute dimnika
instruction:
Preveri delovanje izhoda (OUT6). Ob izklopljenem izhodu je loputa dimnika odprta. Ob vklopu izhoda se loputa zapre.
Check functionality of (OUT6). When out is turned off the chimnay flap is open. Turen on the out to close the flap.

name: Izhod OUT6 – izklop in zapiranje dimnika
instruction:
Preveri delovanje izhoda (OUT6), Ob izklopu (OUT6) zapiranje diminka
Check functionality of (OUT6), When turning off (OUT6) flaps starts to close

name: Zapiranje lopute dimnika (OUT18)
instruction:
Zapri loputo dimnika (OUT18)
Close chimney flap (OUT18)

name: Vklop hladilnega ventilatorja, lopute in prezračevanja (OUT5–OUT7)
instruction:
Vklopi hladilni ventilator elektronike (OUT5), loputo dimnika (OUT6) in prezračevalni sistem (OUT7)
Turn on cooling fan of electrical plate (OUT5), chimney flap (OUT6) and ventilation system

name: Delovanje izhodov OUT5, OUT6 in OUT7
instruction:
Preveri delovanje izhodov OUT5, OUT6 in OUT7
Check functionality of OUT5, OUT6, OUT7

name: Izklop hladilnega ventilatorja, lopute in prezračevanja (OUT5–OUT7)
instruction:
Izklopi hladilni ventilator elektronike (OUT5), loputo dimnika (OUT6) in Prezračevalni sistem (OUT7)
Turn off cooling fan of electrical plate (OUT5), chimney flap (OUT6) and ventilation system

name: Ventil za vodo na ventilator (OUT2)
instruction:
Test elektromagnetnega ventila za vodo na ventilator (OUT2)
Test electromagnetic valve for ventilator steaming (OUT2)

name: Ventil za vodo v agregat (OUT4)
instruction:
Test elektromagnetnega ventila za vodo v agregat (OUT4).
Test electromagnetic valve for generator steaming (OUT4).

name: Izhod za kljuko OUT18 – odklep in izklop
instruction:
Preveri delovanje izhoda za klujko OUT18. Ob vklopu izhoda se mora sistem zaklepa odkleniti nato izhod (OUT18) izklopite.
Check Function of OUT18. When turned on Lock system should unlock and open the door after that turn off OUT18.

name: Izhod za kljuko OUT18 – odklep in zaklep
instruction:
Preveri delovanje izhoda za klujko OUT18. Ob vklopu izhoda se mora sistem zaklepa odkleniti in zakleniti.
Check Function of OUT18. When turned on Lock system should start locking and unlocking.

name: Prosto gibanje lopute dimnika
instruction:
Preveri prosto gibanje lopute dimnika do skrajnih položajev
Check free movement of chimney flap till end position

name: Izklop OUT12 in OUT14
instruction:
Izklopi (OUT12) in (OUT14).
Turn off (OUT12) and (OUT14).

name: Dotakanje vode za pranje (OUT3)
instruction:
Vklop elektromagnetnega ventila za vodo v odtoku - dotakanje vode do nivoja za pranje (OUT3).
Turn on electromagnetic valve to full up a water drainage - pouring water till washing level (OUT3).

name: Dotakanje vode za pranje (OUT19)
instruction:
Vklop elektromagnetnega ventila za vodo v odtoku - dotakanje vode do nivoja za pranje (OUT19).
Turn on electromagnetic valve to full up a water drainage - pouring water till washing level (OUT19).

name: Nizek in visok nivo vode
instruction:
Preveri vklop nizkega in visokega nivoja.
Check if low level and high level switch on.

name: Cev lovilnika pod vrati – odtok
instruction:
Preveri cev za povezavo lovilnika pod vrati - odtok.
Check the hose that connects the water trap.

name: Izklop dotakanja ob doseženem nivoju (OUT19)
instruction:
Pri dosegu nivoja (voda prekrije pokrov odtoka) izklop dotakanja (OUT19).
When the water reaches the desired level (water covers the drain cover) turn off OUT19.

name: Črpalka za pranje 5 min (OUT8)
instruction:
Vklop črpalke za pranje za cca. 5min (OUT8)
Turn on the water pump (OUT8) for about 5.mins

name: Črpalka za pranje 5 min (OUT5)
instruction:
Vklop črpalke za pranje za cca. 5min (OUT5)
Turn on the water pump (OUT5) for about 5.mins

name: Zapiranje USB pokrovčka
instruction:
Zapri USB pokrovček
Close USB cover

name: Delovanje pralne šobe
instruction:
Vizualno preveri delovanje pralne šobe
Visually check water pump operation

name: Odtok vode pod steklom vrat
instruction:
Preveri odtok vode pod steklom vrat
Check drain under door glass

name: Tesnenje peči, varjeni spoji in objemke
instruction:
Preveri tesnenje peči, varjene spoje in objemke
Check oven sealing, welded joints and clamps

name: Tip termične varovalke 420 °C (komora, agregat)
instruction:
Preveri TIP termične varovalke (420°C), 1x (komora, agregat)
Check the type of thermal fuse (420°C), 1x (chamber, steam generator)

name: Tip termične varovalke 315 °C, 2x
instruction:
Preveri TIP termične varovalke (315°C), 2x (komora in parni agregat)
Check the type of thermal fuse (315°C), 2x (chamber and steam generator)

name: Tip termične varovalke 420 °C (komora)
instruction:
Preveri TIP termične varovalke (420°C), 1x (komora)
Check the type of thermal fuse (420°C), 1x (chamber)

name: Tip termične varovalke 420 °C (komora)
instruction:
Preveri TIP termične varovalke (420°C), 1x (komora)
Check the type of thermal fuse (420°C), 1x (chamber)

name: Tip termične varovalke 315 °C (komora)
instruction:
Preveri TIP termične varovalke (315°C), 1x (komora)
Check the type of thermal fuse (315°C), 1x (chamber)

name: RGB izhod pri enkoderju (OUT38–OUT40)
instruction:
Vklop RGB izhoda pri encoderju (OUT38, OUT39, OUT40)
Turn on RGB lights at encoder (OUT38, OUT39, OUT40)

name: Izklop črpalke in odpiranje odtočnega ventila
instruction:
Izklop črpalke za pranje (OUT5), odpri odtočni ventil (OUT7 = OFF)
Turn off water pump (OUT5), open drain valve (OUT7 = OFF)

name: Izklop indikacije nivoja pri odtekanju vode
instruction:
Pri odtekanju vode iz komore na zaslonu preveri izklop indikacije visokega in nizkega nivoja
When water is draining from chamber check on display indications of a high and low-level switch they must turn off

name: Izhod iz IO MENU na MANUAL
instruction:
Izhod iz IO MENU (starejši COMM-SETUP), na nastavitev MANUAL
Exit from IO MENU, go to MANUAL menu

name: Vstop v MANUAL način
instruction:
Vstopu v MANUAL mode
Enter in MANUAL menu

name: Grelci parnega agregata v MANUAL načinu
instruction:
Ob vstopu v MANUAL vklopi parni igrat vklopijo se LED na triaku - grelci parnega agregata
Enter in MANUAL menu turn on steam generator LED lights turns on triac

name: Manual način 250 °C, 10 min
instruction:
Vklopi manual mode: 250°C, 10 min, hitrost ventilatorja 2, vlaženje na ventilator 10x
Set manual baking parameters: 250°C, 10 mins, ventilator speed 2, ventlator steaming 10x

name: Vklop in izklop parnega agregata
instruction:
Preizkusi vklop/izklop parnega agregata
Tests the steam generator on / off

name: Termostat na 100 °C
instruction:
Nastavi termostata na 100°C
Set the thermostat to 100 ° C

name: Etaže na 100 °C, 10 min in generator vlaženja
instruction:
Nastavi temperaturo etaž na 100°C in čas pečenja na 10 min ter vklopi generator vlaženja.
Set the temperature of decks to 100 ° C and time of the bakin to 10 minuts and turn on the steam generator,

name: Vklop pečenja po segretju
instruction:
Po segretju etaž in agregrata vklopite pečenje.
After the decks and steam generator are ready start the baking.

name: Termostat na 100 °C in parni agregat
instruction:
Nastavi termostata na 100°C, vklopi parni agregat,
Set the thermostat to 100 ° C, turn on the steam generator,

name: Spodnji in zgornji termostat na 100 °C
instruction:
Nastavi termostat spodnji in zgornji na 100°C
Set the thermostat lower and upper to 100 ° C

name: Manual način 250 °C, 7 min
instruction:
Nastavi manual mode: 250°C, 7 min, 10 hitrost ventilatorja,10x vlaženje na ventilator,vklop
Set manual baking parameters: 250°C, 10 mins, 10 ventilator speed,10x ventilator steaming, start baking

name: Manual način 100 °C, 10 min, vlaženje agregata
instruction:
Nastavi manual mode: 100°C, 10 min in agregat 20x vlaženja agregata
Set manual baking parameters: 100°C, 10 mins and steam generator, 20x steam generator

name: Manual način 250 °C, vlaženje agregata
instruction:
Nastavi manual mode: 250°C, vlaženje - agregat 20x, 10 min, 10 hitrost ventilatorja, vklop
Set manual baking parameters: 250°C, steam generator 20x, 10 mins, 10 ventilator speed, start baking

name: Hladilni ventilator
instruction:
Preveri hladilni ventilator
Check cooling fan

name: Manual predgrevanje na 260 °C
instruction:
Manual predgrevanje na 260°C (cca 12min)
Manual preheating is set on 260°C

name: Ponovni vklop vzhajalnika brez key-bas
instruction:
Sedaj izklopi vzhajalnik in iz vzhajalnika izklopi key-bas. Natoj vklopite vzhajalnik.
Now unplug prover from power supply now unplug key-bas ley from electronic and now turn on the prover

name: Manual predgrevanje na 35 °C
instruction:
Manual predgrevanje na 35°C
Manual preheating is set on 35°C

name: Nastavitev vlage na 70 %
instruction:
Nastavitev vlage na 70%.
Set humidity on 70%.

name: Kontaktor grelca komore
instruction:
Preveri kontaktor za grelec komore?
Check contactor for heater of chamber?

name: Skupni električni tok
instruction:
Meritev skupnega električnega toka
Measure total electrical curent

name: Tok grelca komore
instruction:
Meritev električnega toka grelca komore
Measure electrical curent of chamber heater

name: Tok grelca agregata
instruction:
Meritev električnega toka grelca agregata
Measure electrical curent of steamer heater

name: Agregat – natočena voda in para
instruction:
Preverba agregata. Voda natočena in dela se para?
Check steam generator. Water is pored and steam is generating?

name: Zapiranje vrat – nastavitev
instruction:
Preveriti zapiranje vrat – nastavitev
Check door closing - set as needed

name: Komora doseže temperaturo in vlago
instruction:
Komora doseže temepraturo in vlago?
Chamber reaches set temperature and humidity?

name: Spodnji predal vstavljen
instruction:
Spodnji predal vstavljen?
Bottom water drawer inserted?

internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 178. Meritve v obrazcu: ZD, ZS, ZL.

Measure electrical curent on bottom heater (četrta Floor)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 181. Meritve v obrazcu: SD, SS, SL.

Izmeri tok na grelcu zgoraj (četrta etaža):
Measure electrical curent on top heater (forth Floor)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 182. Meritve v obrazcu: ZD, ZS, ZL.

instruction:
Izmeri tok grelca agregata (spodnja etaža) (7,8 A) :
Measure electrical curent on steam heater (bottom floor) (7,8 A)

instruction:
Izmeri tok grelca agregata (druga etaža)(7,8 A):
Measure electrical curent on steam heater (second floor) (7,8 A)

Measure electrical curent on bottom heater (third Floor) (7,8 A)

instruction:
Izmeri tok grelca agregata (četrta etaža) (7,8 A):
Measure electrical curent on bottom heater (Forth Floor) (7,8 A)

Measure total electrical curent:
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 187. Meritve v obrazcu: F1, F2, F3, N (v obrazcu 48.4).

instruction:

HTB-8, TP-8, FB8-S, FB8-S CL (20.54, 20.54, 20.54 A) Measure electrical curent on main heater: HTB-5(12.33, 16.44, 16.44 A), HTB-8, TP-8, FB8-S, FB8-S CL (20.54, 20.54, 20.54 A)

instruction:
Izmeri tok grelca agregata na triaku: HTB-5, HTB-8, HTB-10, TP-5, TP-8, TP-10 (7,8,3.9 A)
Measure electrical curent on triac board: HTB-5, HTB-8, HTB-10, TP-5, TP-8, TP-10 (7,8,3.9 A)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 191. Meritve v obrazcu: Pl, Pd.

internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 192. Meritve v obrazcu: SD, SL.

Measure electrical curent on top heater
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 193. Meritve v obrazcu: ZD, ZL.

instruction:
Izmeri tok na grelcu spodaj (druga etaža):
Measure electrical curent on bottom heater (second Floor)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 194. Meritve v obrazcu: SD, SL.

instruction:

Measure electrical curent on bottom heater (second Floor)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 195. Meritve v obrazcu: ZD, ZL.

instruction:

Measure electrical curent on bottom heater (third Floor)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 196. Meritve v obrazcu: SD, SL.

name: Tok grelca zgoraj – tretja etaža
instruction:
Izmeri tok na grelcu spodaj (tretja etaža):
Measure electrical curent on bottom heater (third Floor)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 197. Meritve v obrazcu: ZD, ZL (v obrazcu piše »spodaj«).

name: Prikaz temperature komore
instruction:
Preveri prikaz temperature komore
Check temperature of main chamber

name: Glavni kontaktor K1
instruction:
Preveri glavni kontaktor K1
Check main contactor K1

name: Izklop lučke za grelce ob doseženi temperaturi
instruction:
Ob doseženi temperaturi , izklopi lucko za grelce
When reaching set temperature, light for heaters turnes off

name: Termostat na 120 °C
instruction:
Nastavi termostat na 120°C
Set temperature on 120°C

name: Ponoven vklop grelcev in lučke
instruction:
Ponovno se vklopta grelca in zasveti lučka?
Heaters turn on againa and the light illuminates?

name: Ponovna meritev toka na grelcih
instruction:
Ponovno pomeri tok na grelcih
Again check curent on heaters.

name: Termostat na 0 °C
instruction:
Nastavi termostat na 0°C
Set temperature on 0°C

name: Lučka ob doseženi temperaturi in segretem agregatu
instruction:
Ob doseženi temperaturi predgrevanja ter segretju agregata, zasveti lučka?
When the preheat temperature is reached and the steam heater is ready, does the light illuminate?

name: Ročno vlaženje
instruction:
Preizkusi ročno vlaženje
Try manual steaming

name: Tesnenje vrat med vlaženjem
instruction:
Ob vlaženju pri temperaturi preveri tesnenje peči pri vratih
When steamig proces at temperature, check the leakage of steam at the oven door

name: Ponovno segrevanje agregata
instruction:
Po vlaženju ponovno segrej agregat
After the steaming process, re-heat the steaming generator

name: Funkcija zmanjšanja moči
instruction:
Preveri delovanje funkcije zmanjšanja moči (pri HTB-5, TP05 )
Check Power Function of power reduction (HTB-5, TP05)

name: Stikalo vrat in piskač – »Close the door«
instruction:
Preverjanje stikala vrat in piskača - odpri vrata v predgrevanju -> napis na LCD-ju:"Close the door"
Check door switchand buzzer - Open ooor in preheating -> sign on LCD: "Close the door"

name: Tok glavnega grelca FB-S CL
instruction:
Izmeri tok na glavnem grelcu: FB-S Cl (12.33, 16.44, 16.44 A)
Measure electrical curent on main heater: FB-S CL(12.33, 16.44, 16.44 A)
internal_note: Obrazec Končni preizkus, točka 211. Meritve v obrazcu: F1, F2, F3.

name: Stikalo vrat – »Close the door«
instruction:
Preverjanje stikala vrat - odpri vrata v predgrevanju -> LCD:"Close the door!
Checking the door switch - Open the door in preheating -> LCD: "Close the door!

name: Vrtenje ventilatorja med predgrevanjem
instruction:
Med predgrevanjem preveri vrtenje ventilatorja (levo, desno)
During preheating check the fan rotation (left, right)

name: Temperatura glavnega motorja M1 (pod 140 °C)
instruction:
Z laserskim merilcem izmeri temperaturo na glavnem motorju motorju (M1). Temperatura mora biti pod 140°C.
Use laser measurment to measure temperature on main motor (M1). Temperature must be under 140°C.

name: Pok stekla vrat pri 260 °C
instruction:
Do konca predgrevanja (260°C) pazi na morebiten pok stekla vrat! Preizkus 2min pri 260°C.
Until the end of preheating (260 °C), keep an eye out the inner might glass blow up can! 2 min test at 260 °C.

name: Zvočni signal ob doseženem predgrevanju
instruction:
Ob doseženi temperaturi predgrevanja zvočni signal?
Is the acoustic signal reached when the preheat temperature is reached?

name: Zvočni signal ob predgrevanju in segretem agregatu
instruction:
Ob doseženi temperaturi predgrevanja in segretju agregata zvočni signal?
Is the acoustic signal reached when the preheat temperature is reached and the unit is heated?

name: Aktivacija Manual programa z odpiranjem vrat
instruction:
"Vstavljanje izdelkov", aktivacija pričetka Manual programa z odpiranjem vrat
"Product Insertion", activation of manual program by opening doors

name: Loputa dimnika ob vlaženju
instruction:
Preveri loputo dimnika ob vlaženju - odpiranje lopute zaradi pritiska pare
Check the chimney flap at steaming - chimmney flap opens due to steam pressure

name: Spreminjanje hitrosti ventilatorja
instruction:
Med delovanjem spreminjaj hitrost ventilatorja
Change the fan speed during operation

name: Vodila in prekriv glavnega grelca (brez logotipa W)
instruction:
Preveri vstavljenost vodil, preveri vstavljenost pravilnega prekriva (brez logotipa W) glavnega grelca
Check tray holders insertion, check insertion of correct overlay (without W logo) of main heater

name: Ohladitev peči
instruction:
Ohladi peč
Cool the oven

name: Izbira programa TEST 98
instruction:
Izberi program TEST 98
Choose program named TEST 98

name: Izbira predgretja
instruction:
Izberi predgretje
Choose preheating

name: Zvočni signal ob doseženi temperaturi in vlagi
instruction:
Preveri ob doseženi temperaturi in vlagi zvočni signal
Check for sound signal at reached temperature and humidity

name: Zvočni signal ob doseženi temperaturi
instruction:
Preveri ob doseženi temperaturi zvočni signal
Check for sound signal at reached temperature

name: Aktivacija programa z odpiranjem vrat
instruction:
"Vstavljanje izdelkov", aktivacija pričetka programa z odpiranjem vrat
"Product insertion", activation of the program by opening the door

name: Loputa dimnika ob vlaženju
instruction:
Preveri loputo dimnika ob vlaženju - odpiranje lopute zaradi pritiska pare
Check the chimney flap st steaming - openning of flap due to steam pressure

name: Vlaženje in pavza ventilatorja
instruction:
Preveri vlaženje in pavzo ventilatorja po vlaženju
Check steaming and pouse of the fan after steaming

name: Ključavnica in vrata pri segreti peči
instruction:
Pri segreti peči preveri delovanje ključavnice, vrat
When the oven is heated, check the function of the door lock

name: 1. in 2. stopnja hitrosti motorja
instruction:
preveri 1. in 2. stopnjo hitrosti motorja
check high and low speed of main fan motor

name: Tesnenje vrat in nastavitev
instruction:
preveri tesnenje vrat, če ne tesnijo jih nastavi
check the door sealing and adjust if neecessary

name: Ročno vlaženje
instruction:
Preizkusi ročno vlaženje
Test manaual steaming

name: Tipka »open chimney flap«
instruction:
Preizkus delovanja odpiranja lopute s tipko "open chimney flap" (preveri odpiranje in zapiranje)
Test chimney flap (open and close check) with chimney icon

name: Glavni motor v obe smeri
instruction:
Preveri delovanje glavnega motorja v obe smeri
Check main motor for rotation in both directions

name: Konec Manual programa in aktivacija programa
instruction:
Ob koncu Manual programa, zvočni signal, aktivacija programa z odpiranjem in zapiranjem vrat
At the end of the Manual program check for an audio signal, program activation by opening and closing the door

name: Zagon programa TEST 99
instruction:
Izberi Programski način, zaženi TEST 99.
Select Program mode, run TEST 99.

name: Polni pogled na zaslonu
instruction:
Z dotikom na ikono prehoda na drugi zaslon vklopi polni pogled.
By touching the icon for switching to the second screen, enable full view.

name: Cooling – loputa dimnika in prezračevanje
instruction:
Delovanje "Cooling", odpiranje lopute dimnika in ob koncu hlajenja odprtje prezračevalne lopute.
Function "Cooling", opening of chimney flap andat the end ventilation flap will open.

name: Ponovna kontrola tesnenja, spojev in objemk
instruction:
Ponovno preveri tesnenje peči, varjene spoje, objemke.
Check sealing of oven, welded joints, clamps.

name: Izklop zvočnega signala po predgretju
instruction:
Zvočni signal ob končanem predgretju izklopimo s dotikom na zaslon.
To mute the audio at the end of preheating, touch the screen.

name: Aktivacija programske peke po hlajenju
instruction:
Po koncu hlajenja z odpiranjem in zapiranjem vrat aktiviramo programski način peke.
After cooling is completed, the baking mode is activated by opening and closing the door.

name: Aktivacija programske peke po predgrevanju
instruction:
Po koncu predgrevanja z odpiranjem in zapiranjem vrat aktiviramo programski način peke
After preheating is completed, the baking mode is activated by opening and closing the door

name: Vlaženje in pavza motorja
instruction:
Vlaženje in pavza motorja.
Steaming and pause.

name: Ročno vlaženje na ventilator po avtomatskem
instruction:
Po avtomatskem vlaženju, preizkus ročnega vlaženja na ventilator
After automatic steaming, test and try the manual steaming on fan motor

name: Ročno vlaženje na ventilator po avtomatskem
instruction:
Po avtomatskem vlaženju, preizkus ročnega vlaženja na ventilator
After automatic steaming, test and try the manual steaming on fan motor

name: Zvočni signal med menjavo faz programa
instruction:
Preveri, zvočni signal med menjanjem faz programa.
Check for an audio signal while changing program phases.

name: Loputa dimnika v 3. in 4. fazi (TEST 99)
instruction:
v 3. fazi pečenja preveri odpiranje lopute dimnika, v 4. fazi pa zapiranje (v programu test 99)
check opening of chimney in 3. phase and closing of chimney in 4. phase (in program test 99)

name: Loputa dimnika v 5. in 6. fazi (TEST 99)
instruction:
v 5. fazi pečenja preveri odpiranje lopute dimnika, v 6. fazi pa zapiranje (v programu test 99)
check opening of chimney in 5. phase and closing of chimney in 6. phase (in program test 99)

name: Zaznava odprtih vrat med peko
instruction:
Pri odpiranju vrat med peko mora zaznati odprta vrata, na prvi stopnji mora motor ustaviti, javi napako
When opening the door during baking, it must detect the door open, at the first stage the engine must stop and report door open

name: Dodatni čas 1 min (1x pritisk)
instruction:
Ob koncu programske peke, takoj ob pisku, nastavi dodaten čas 1 minuto s tipko "Dodatni čas", 1x pritisk
At the end of the program baking, right after the beep, set an additional time of 1 minute with the "Extra time" button, 1x press

name: Nastavitev osnovnega menija po testu
instruction:
Po kocu testa nastavi osnovni meni
After the test set on basic menu

name: Loputa dimnika v 5. fazi programa
instruction:
Preveri, ali v 5 fazi programa odpre loputo dimnika.
Check if the chimmny flap opens in 5 faze of the program.

name: Loputa prezračevanja in ventilator v 6. fazi
instruction:
Preveri, ali se v 6 fazi prgrama odpre loputa prezračevanja in vklopi ventilator.
Check if air flap chimmnay opens and if the venteilator starts spining in the faze 6.

name: Dodatni čas 1 min (2x pritisk)
instruction:
Ob koncu programske peke, takoj ob pisku, nastavi dodaten čas 1 minuto s tipko "Dodatni čas", 2x pritisk
At the end of the program baking, right after the beep, set an additional time of 1 minute with the "Extra time" button, 2x press

name: Ročno vlaženje na ventilator po avtomatskem
instruction:
Po avtomatskem vlaženju, preizkus ročnega vlaženja na ventilator
After automatic steaming, test and try the manual steaming on fan motor

name: Odznačitev TEST 99 v urejevalniku receptov
instruction:
Po koncu TEST programa, odznači TEST 99 iz urejevalnika receptov
After completing the TEST program, unmark TEST 99 from the recipe editor

name: Prijava s kodo 3348 in Test cleaning
instruction:
V nastavitvah se prijav s kodo 3348 in nato v vklopi Test celaning.
In the settings, log in with the code 3348 and then turn on Test Cleaning.

name: Vklop CLEANING I.
instruction:
Vklopi CLEANING I.,
Turn on CLEANING I.,

name: Priprava na pranje (hlajenje, predpranje)
instruction:
Priprava na pranje (hlajenje, predpranje)
Preparation for cleaning (cooling, pre-washing)

name: Zaklenjena ključavnica
instruction:
Preveri ali je ključavnica zaklenjena.
Check if lock sistem is locked.

name: Vstavitev čistila in nadaljevanje pranja
instruction:
Obvestilo o vstavljanju čistila, vstavi čistilo - zapri vrata - pranje se nadaljuje
Wait for cleaner insertion notice, insert the cleaner - close the door - the washing continues

name: Ponovna kontrola zaklenjene ključavnice
instruction:
Ponovno preveri ali je ključavnica zaklenjena.
Check again if lock sistem is locked.

name: Pralna šoba med pranjem
instruction:
Med pranjem preveri delovanje pralne šobe
During cleaning check the operation of the washer nozzle

name: Ponovna kontrola tesnenja, spojev in objemk
instruction:
Ponovno preveri tesnenje peči, varjene spoje, objemke
Recheck the oven seals, welded joints, clamps

name: General information po peki
instruction:
Po koncu peke peč in preveri "General information", prikazan čas, datum in recepte
At the end of baking, check the "General Information" displaying the time, date and recipes

name: General information po pranju
instruction:
Po koncu pranja vklopi peč in preveri "General information", prikazan čas, datum in recepte
At the end of cleaning, check the "General Information" displaying the time, date and recipes

name: Raziglani robovi
instruction:
Preveri, če so robovi raziglani.
Clean the washer nozzle

name: Vizualni pregled znotraj in zunaj
instruction:
Vizualno znotraj in zunaj preveri peč (izvedeno pred končno montažo prizvoda)
Visually inspect the oven inside and outside (performed before final assembly of the product)

name: Segretje agregata za uporabo
instruction:
Ponovno v manual programu segrej agregat, če ni segret za uporabo
Again in the manual program warm up the steam generator if it is not already heated

name: Ostanek vode v agregatu
instruction:
Preveri, če je ostaja voda v agregatu
Check if water remains in the unit

name: Odziv zaslona in touch panela
instruction:
Delovanje in odziv zaslona (in touch panela) skozi postopek preizkusa
Check the operation and response of the screen (and touch panel) through the test process

name: Silikon na notranjih robovih
instruction:
Preveri, če je na notranjih robovih silikon
Check inside edges for silicone

name: Izklop peči s tipko in stikalom
instruction:
Izklopi peč s tipko nato s stikalom
Switch off the oven with the button then with the switch

name: Izklop s stikalom
instruction:
Izklopi s stikalom
Switching off

name: Izklop s tipko OFF
instruction:
Izklop s tipko "OFF
Swich off with "OFF"

name: Inštalacijski odklopnik vklopljen
instruction:
Preveri inštalaciski odklopnik, če je vklopljen
Check the installation circuit breaker if it is on

name: Parameter 00.20 Delta T na 150 °C
instruction:
Vklopi peč in nastavi parameter 00.20. Delta T na 150°C. Nato izklopi peč.
Turn on the oven and set the parameter to 00.20. Set Delta T to 150°C. Then turn off the oven.

name: Datum in ura v stand-by načinu
instruction:
Preveri datum in uro v stand-by-u
Check the date and time in stand-by

name: Stanje Brite in poraba vode
instruction:
Stanje Brite ob koncu testa/ poraba vode - zapiši
Condition Brite at end of test / water consumption - write down

name: Potreba po nalaganju Oven Managerja
instruction:
Preveri, če je potrebno naložiti Oven Manager
Check if Oven Manager needs to be loaded

name: Praznjenje agregata
instruction:
Praznjenje agregata, s črpalko se izprazni voda
Emptey the steam generator, water is emptied with water pump

name: Končni vizualni pregled pred embaliranjem
instruction:
Končni vizualni pregled proizvoda pred embaliranjem (prisotne nesmejo biti praske, udrtine itd.)
Final visual inspection of the product before packaging (scratches, dents, etc.,)

name: Ožičenje elektro plošče
instruction:
Na elektro plošči preveri ožičenje.
Check the wiring on the electrical panel.

name: Priklop brike za TF1 in TF2
instruction:
Na elektro ploščo priklopi briko za TF1 in TF2.
Connect the bridge for TF1 and TF2 to the electrical panel.

name: Priklop LED indikacije EMV, nape in motorja
instruction:
Na elektro ploščo priklopi led indikacijo za EMV, 1 in 2 hitrost nape, belimo motor.
Connect the LED indication for EMV, 1st and 2nd speed of the hood, bleach motor to the electrical panel.

name: Priklop enofaznega napajalnega kabla
instruction:
Na elektro ploščo priklopi enofazni napajalni kabel.
Connect the single-phase power cable to the electrical panel.

name: Odklop žice na kontaktorju K1 (T1)
instruction:
Na elektro plošči odklopi žico na kontaktorju K1 kontakt T1.
Disconnect the wire at contactor K1 contact T1 on the electrical panel.

name: Priklop main boarda in temperaturnih sond
instruction:
Na elektro ploščo priklopi main board in priklopi temperaturne sonde (2x 1,5m in 1x 2,0m) na main board.
Connect the main board to the electrical panel and connect the temperature probes(2x 1,5m and 1x 2,0m) to the main board.

name: USB s FW, Erase Flash in aktivacijska koda
instruction:
Vstavi USB z FW-jem v krmilnik in prikolpi na preizkusno mesto. Preveri za Erase Flash ob zagonu in nato vpiši aktivacisko kodo.
Insert the USB with FW into the controller and connect it to the test location. Check for Erase Flash at startup and then enter the activation code.

name: Vstop v servisni meni (koda 1234)
instruction:
Vklopi krmilnik in vstopi v servisni meni, s kodo 1234.
Enter in service menu, with code 1234.

name: Ura, datum in časovna kalibracija
instruction:
Nastavi uro, datum in časovno kalibracijo (64)
Set the clock, date, and time calibration (64)

name: Vstop v IO MENU
instruction:
Vstop v IO MENU (starejši COMM-SETUP).
Enter in IO Menu (old COMM-SETUP).

name: Prikaz temperature generatorja pare T-st
instruction:
Preveri prikaz temperature generatorja pare T-st (prikaz temp. je enak ambientalne temp.)
Check the steam generator temperature display T-st (displayed temp. is same as ambienal temp.)

name: Kontaktor K1 (OUT1) in LED prve hitrosti nape
instruction:
Vklop glavnega kontaktorja K1 (OUT1) vklopijo Led indikacija za prvo hitrosti nape.
Turn on the main contactor K1 (OUT1) to activate the LED indication for the first hood speed.

name: Elektromagnetni ventil agregata (OUT2)
instruction:
Vkolp elektromagnetnega ventila za v agregat (OUT2) preveri delovanje (indikacijo led) nato izklopite elektromagnetni ventil (OUT2).
Activate the water solenoid valve for the unit (OUT2), check operation (LED indication), then turn off the solenoid valve (OUT2).

name: Kontaktor zgornjega grelca (OUT3)
instruction:
Preizkus vkolopa in izklopa kontaktorja zgornjega grelca (OUT3)
Test the operation of turning on and off the top heater contactor (OUT3)

name: Kontaktor spodnjega grelca (OUT19)
instruction:
Preizkus vkolopa in izklopa kontaktorja spodnjega grelca (OUT19)
Test the operation of turning on and off the bottom heater contactor (OUT19)

name: Kontaktor grelcev agregata (OUT7)
instruction:
Preizkus vkolopa in izklopa kontaktorja za grelce agregata (OUT7)
Test the operation of turning on and off the contactor for the unit heaters (OUT7)

name: Odpiranje lopute dimnika (OUT6)
instruction:
Odpiranje lopute dimnika (OUT6) preveri delovanje (Led indikacijo) nato iklopi (OUT6).
Open the chimney flap (OUT6), check operation (LED indication), then turn off (OUT6).

name: Zapiranje lopute dimnika (OUT18)
instruction:
Zapiranje lopute dimnika (OUT18) preveri delovanje (Led indikacijo) nato iklopi (OUT18).
Close the chimney flap (OUT18), check operation (LED indication), then turn off (OUT18).

name: Druga hitrost nape (OUT5)
instruction:
Delovanje druge hitrosti nape (OUT5) preveri delovanje (led indikacijo) nato izklopi (OUT5)
Test the operation of the second speed of the hood (OUT5), check operation (LED indication), then turn off (OUT5)

name: LED osvetlitev (OUT4)
instruction:
Vklop LED osvetlitve z vkolpom izhoda OUT4 preveri delovanje nato izklopiti izhod OUT4.
Turn on the LED lighting by activating output OUT4, check its operation, and then deactivate output OUT4.

name: Izhod iz IO MENU na MANUAL
instruction:
Izhod iz IO MENU (starejši COMM-SETUP), na nastavitev MANUAL
Exit from IO MENU, go to MANUAL menu

name: Vstop v MANUAL način
instruction:
Vstopu v MANUAL mode
Enter in MANUAL menu

name: Prikaz temperature etaž
instruction:
Preveri prikaz temperature zgornje in spodnje etaže. Prikaz trenutne temperature je sobna temperatura.
Check the temperature display of the upper and lower floors. The current temperature display is room temperature.

name: Vklop kontaktorjev in izklop K2–K4
instruction:
Vklop vseh kontaktorjev. Zmašaj temperaturo zgornje in spodnje etaže na 10°C in izklopi agregat in preveri izklop K2, K3 in K4.
Contactors turn on. Set the temperature of the upper and lower floors to 10°C, turn off the generator, and check the shutdown of K2, K3, and K4.

name: Izklop krmilnika in preizkusnega mesta
instruction:
Izklopi krmilnik in nato izklopi iz preizkusnega mesta
Turn off the controller and then disconnect from the testing place.

name: Odklop testnih priključkov in priklop žice na kontaktor
instruction:
Na elektro pošči odklopimo vse led indikacije, napajalni kabel, brike in nazaj priklopimo žico na kontaktor
On the electrical panel, disconnect all LED indications, the power cable, bridges, and reconnect the wire to the contactor.

name: Kontrola ožičenja
instruction:
Preveri ožičenje.
Check the wiring.
